allow: Bash(git commit -m "chore: finalize workspace localization and project updates:*)
Bash(git commit -m "chore: clean up unused files:*)
Bash(git commit -m "chore: fix node_modules symlink and update permissions:*)

hooks.command:
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' | grep -qE 'src/.*[.]tsx$' && jq -cn '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"MOBILE RULES (docs/FRONTEND.md):
1. STEPPER: grid-cols-N + absolute connectors (top-[18px] left-1/2), not flex
2. GRIDS: 3 cards = grid-cols-3 always; hints hidden sm:block
3. SELECTS: Never native <select> - always use <AdminSelect/> from ui/AdminSelect.tsx
4. INPUTS: h-[50px] min-height, inline blur validation
5. TOUCH: min 44px tap targets (h-11 or p-3)
6. TEXT: body>=15px, labels>=12px, micro>=10px
7. SPACING: px-4 sm:px-6, p-3 sm:p-4 for cards
8. TEST at 375px viewport before marking done"}}' || true
